content.value_statement: Technical slide decks often need code, diagrams, animation, and export settings. This skill gives Claude and Codex focused Slidev guidance for Markdown-based presentations.
actual_capabilities: Explains Slidev Markdown syntax, frontmatter, layouts, slots, and presenter notes.
Guides code-focused slides with highlighting, line numbers, Monaco editor examples, and magic move animations.
Covers diagrams and math using Mermaid, PlantUML, and LaTeX syntax.
Helps configure animations, drawing tools, draggable elements, and click-driven reveal behavior.
Provides build, export, PDF, SEO, remote asset, and hosting references for Slidev projects.
Summarizes presenter tools such as recording, timers, notes, and remote control options.
limitations: It is a reference skill and does not include a Slidev runtime or project files.
It cannot verify visual output unless the local Slidev project is run and inspected.
Some workflows require package manager commands, Playwright, browser permissions, or network access.
Advanced theme behavior still depends on the installed Slidev version and project configuration.

use_cases.title: Create a Developer Talk
use_cases.description: Draft a Slidev deck with code examples, diagrams, presenter notes, and export-ready settings.
use_cases.target_user: Software engineers preparing conference or meetup talks

use_cases.title: Teach Technical Concepts
use_cases.description: Build lessons that reveal code step by step and include runnable examples or diagrams.

use_cases.title: Refine Existing Slidev Decks
use_cases.description: Improve layouts, animation timing, SEO metadata, presenter tools, and export configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start a new presentation from a topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Slidev presentation outline about [topic]. Include a cover slide, three main sections, presenter notes, and simple frontmatter.

prompt_templates.title: Add Code and Diagrams
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: enrich a technical deck with developer features.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my Slidev deck to add highlighted code examples, a Mermaid diagram, click reveals, and speaker notes for each major idea.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: configure delivery and sharing settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Slidev deck for PDF export, social metadata, remote assets, presenter timer settings, and audience-friendly navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Conference Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: improve an existing deck before delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Slidev presentation for structure, layout consistency, animation pacing, code readability, presenter workflow, and export reliability.

output_examples.input: Create a Slidev deck for a TypeScript generics workshop.
output: A structured deck plan with a cover, concept slides, worked examples, exercises, and closing resources.
Slidev-specific guidance for code highlighting, click reveals, diagrams, and presenter notes.

output_examples.input: Improve my existing deck before a conference talk.
output: A review of slide flow, layout choices, animation pacing, visual hierarchy, and speaker support.
Actionable changes for export settings, SEO metadata, timers, and audience sharing.

output_examples.input: Add interactive code demonstrations to a Slidev presentation.
output: Recommendations for Monaco editor usage, runnable examples, safe file editing, and fallback static examples.
A concise checklist for testing browser behavior before presenting.

best_practices: Keep slides source-controlled before using writable editor or live coding features.
Ask before running package manager, build, export, remote, or tunnel commands.
Preview exported PDF or SPA output before sharing the deck with an audience.
anti_patterns: Do not enable remote access or tunnels without a password and explicit user approval.
Do not place private diagrams, secrets, or unreleased content in third-party hosted assets.
Do not rely on animation-heavy slides without testing export and presenter mode first.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants create, edit, explain, and prepare Slidev presentations for technical audiences.

faq.question: Does it install Slidev automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Package manager commands should run only with user approval.

faq.question: Can it work with existing Slidev decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review Markdown slides, frontmatter, layouts, animations, presenter notes, and export settings.

faq.question: Does it support code-heavy presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers code highlighting, line numbers, Monaco editor options, magic move, and imported snippets.

faq.question: What should users check before presenting?
faq.answer: Users should preview the deck, test animations, verify presenter notes, and confirm export output.

faq.question: Are remote and recording features safe?
faq.answer: They are normal Slidev features, but users should approve browser permissions, passwords, and network exposure.
